_meta.purpose: Physical-risk engine configuration. Thresholds and mappings live here, not buried in code, so they can be changed without touching the calculation (docs/physical-risk-methodology.md).

risk_levels.attribution: climaterisk custom methodology, GRESB-informed framework. NOT an official GRESB threshold.

potential_loss.note: The representative PML return period. Reported only when the event set can resolve it; CLIMADA's calc_freq_curve saturates at the largest event instead of returning NaN, so an unresolvable request is recorded as null with calculation_status RETURN_PERIOD_NOT_RESOLVABLE.

simple_summary._note: Simple-mode summary (src/climaterisk/physical_risk/simple_summary.py): what the one-screen view flags. Display choices, not model parameters.

portfolio_loss_curve.note: Return periods of the portfolio (and per-province) loss curve: per-event losses of every priced asset under one hazard set are added, then read through CLIMADA Impact.calc_freq_curve. Not the sum of per-asset return-period losses. A return period outside the curve's own range is null (RETURN_PERIOD_NOT_RESOLVABLE / SHORTER_THAN_CURVE), never the clamped end value.

coastal_flood.note: Models-tab coastal flood (CF) = WRI Aqueduct Floods v2 inuncoast GeoTIFFs. Future layers use the 50th-percentile sea-level-rise projection (Aqueduct token 0_perc_50; the bare 0 is the 95th); historical layers carry no SLR percentile. wtsub = with land subsidence. The portfolio bbox is padded and snapped outward so nearby portfolios reuse one cached read.

flood_protection.rule: A location protected to a design return period P does not flood in events up to P; rarer events overtop and flood with their full depth (CLIMADA / ISIMIP-FLOPROS protection-standard rule). Applied per hazard grid cell via Hazard.local_exceedance_intensity (stepfunction). One national value per hazard — not the defence actually in place at a site. A cell that floods even at the 2-year event without defences is flagged: in reality it must sit behind sea walls, levees or pumps.

levee_protected.basis: A 배수펌프장 only exists where a river levee encloses low land (제내지) — it lifts interior water over the levee. Grid cells within radius_km of a pump station the publisher located are treated as levee-protected urban reaches and get the lower bound of 하천기본계획 수립지침 B급 (도시구간, 100~200년). radius_km is a platform assumption (no public 배수구역 polygons); pumps come from assets/libraries/korea_pump_stations.csv. The pumps' own 계획빈도 (mostly 20-30 y) is an interior-drainage design rainfall, reported on the row, never used as the levee standard.

RF.basis: Lowest plan scale in 하천기본계획 수립지침 (환경부고시, 2023.10.31), §4.1 하천의 계획규모: A급 200년 이상, B급 100~200년, C급(지방하천) 50~200년; older practice 지방하천 50년 / 국가하천 100년 (KDI 2002). The national minimum is used so protection is never overstated; 한강 and other A-grade reaches are protected well beyond it.

CF.basis: Port outer facilities (breakwaters) were designed to a 50-year wave until the 2021-11-08 uplift to 100 years for major trade ports (press report; KDS 64 clause not verified). No published return period was found for 방조제 (Saemangeum sea-wall data give design wave/level and freeboard only). The lower, pre-2021 value is used so protection is never overstated.

property_type_to_jrc_sector._note: Maps portfolio property_type onto the JRC sectors ImpfRiverFlood exposes. The mapping is a platform choice, not a JRC one — see methodology 5.

definitions.probability: Annual exceedance frequency of the stated return period, taken as 1 / return_period_years. CLIMADA frequency is in 1/year; for rare events this equals annual exceedance probability, for frequent events (freq >= 1/yr) it does not - see methodology 10.
definitions.return_period: 1 / cumulative annual exceedance frequency, as produced by CLIMADA Impact.calc_freq_curve.
definitions.eal: Expected Annual Loss = Impact.aai_agg = sum(at_event * frequency). Verified identity, not a re-implementation.
definitions.potential_loss: Loss at the configured return period, read from Impact.calc_freq_curve.

exposure_growth.definition: Economic-growth step of the ECA decomposition (today's risk -> + economic growth -> + climate change). Asset values are stated in valuation_year and grow to target_year: value_T = value_t0 x (1 + annual_growth_pct/100)^(target_year - valuation_year). Reported as a scalar on EAL and potential loss after the CLIMADA run - exact because impact = value x MDD x PAA is linear in value and this engine sets no deductible or cover - so rows keep the valuation-year values, risk bands (EAL / assets) are unchanged, and climate_change_multiplier (future / baseline EAL at the same exposure) stays a pure climate signal.
